title: Born in Pittsburgh
description: Born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and raised in the suburb of Mt. Lebanon. Both parents were entrepreneurs — father a diamond salesman, mother a photographer.

title: Sister Jessica born
description: Younger sister, Jessica.

title: Started piano at age six
description: Began piano lessons via the Suzuki method.

title: Studied with Vince Leschade
description: Took piano lessons with Vince Leschade, organist for the Pirates and Penguins, from around age nine through late high school, with a fading interest toward the end.

title: Little League: All-Star and Travel teams
description: Played youth baseball; made both the All-Star team and the Travel team.

title: Childhood entrepreneurial hustles
description: A string of small kid ventures: the Bagel Express bagel-delivery service at age 15, selling candy in the school cafeteria until getting shut down, and painting house numbers on curbs with his friend Luke.

title: Got into Fugazi, followed them on tour
description: Musical taste evolved from Billy Joel to Elton John before Fugazi became his favorite band; followed them around on tour.

title: Piano reignites via a Steinway-store teacher
description: Late in high school, a teacher at the Steinway store rekindled his interest, introducing Chopin études — his first real pull toward classical music after years of Billy Joel and the Rhapsody in Blue transcription.

title: Graduated Mt. Lebanon High School
description: Finished high school in Mt. Lebanon.

title: Started at Northwestern in materials science engineering
description: Entered Northwestern University as a materials science engineering major; first year lived in the performing-arts residential college (Jones).

title: Carnegie Mellon summer internship
description: An internship at Carnegie Mellon made clear he didn't want engineering and wanted to stay in music — the pivot point back toward a music path.

title: Transferred into the Northwestern School of Music
description: Sophomore year, switched into the Bienen School of Music, studying music technology with a minor in piano.

title: WWOOF in New Zealand
description: Spent about two and a half months doing WWOOF (Willing Workers on Organic Farms) in New Zealand with his friend Tim.

title: Chicago-area apartment years
description: A run of post–freshman-year housing: off-campus on Clark Street in Evanston (rooming with Mark Roberts, then Doug Torrance, then Aaron With), then Rogers Park, Bucktown, and Lincoln Park.

title: Graduated Northwestern with a music degree
description: Earned a B.A. from the Bienen School of Music (music technology).

title: Odd-jobs era
description: A cluster of early jobs: Apple specialist at Knobbies, waiter at Blind Faith Café (eventually fired), computer repair at Howard Brown Health Center, and an at-home Apple consulting gig advertised in the Chicago Reader and on Craigslist.

title: LSAT and the almost-law-school detour
description: Considered law school and took the LSAT; strong on practice tests but landed in the 160s on the real one.

title: Built Policy Tree
description: Created Policy Tree, a visualization tool for policy debates — the project that led him toward the Harris School.

title: Met and started dating Jenny
description: Met Jenny Gillespie at Hungry Brain and started dating on St. Patrick's Day 2006.

title: Bought a Hyde Park condo for grad school
description: Purchased a ~$120K condo in Hyde Park when starting graduate school nearby — a decision he later judged ill-advised.

title: Harris School, then dropped out
description: Enrolled at the University of Chicago's Harris School of Public Policy to work on ideas like Policy Tree, then dropped out about a quarter in to start The Point.

title: Founded The Point
description: Started The Point, a grassroots collective-action platform, seeded with roughly $1M from Eric Lefkofsky.

title: Founded Groupon
description: Pivoted The Point's collective-buying mechanic into Groupon, becoming founding CEO.

title: Turned down Google's ~$6B offer
description: Declined Google's roughly $6 billion acquisition offer for Groupon.

title: Forbes cover / fastest-growing-company moment
description: Public peak of the Groupon era, with Groupon framed as one of the fastest-growing companies ever and Mason on the cover of Forbes.

title: Bought the Ukrainian Village place
description: Bought a beloved home in Ukrainian Village where he and Jenny lived and were married.

title: Married Jenny Gillespie
description: Married Jenny at Dunton Springs.

title: Groupon IPO
description: Groupon went public, raising roughly $700M at a ~$12.7B valuation.

title: Honeymoon in South Africa
description: Honeymoon trip to South Africa over the winter holidays.

title: Bought the Evanston lakefront house
description: In the roughly six months before being fired, bought a beautiful house in Evanston right on the lake.

title: Ousted as Groupon CEO
description: Fired as CEO of Groupon, marked by an unusually candid goodbye memo.

title: Phat Camp and Pritikin Camp
description: Back-to-back stays at Phat Camp and the Pritikin program in Florida in early 2013.

title: South Asia trip
description: Traveled through South Asia just after leaving Groupon.

title: Recorded a motivational business album
description: Made a motivational/business-themed music album in the wake of the Groupon departure.

title: Cross-country road trip to San Francisco
description: Drove from the Midwest to San Francisco with Jenny (pregnant with Sebastian), stopping at national parks along the way.

title: Moved to San Francisco (Presidio Heights)
description: Settled in Presidio Heights on Pacific Avenue (3577 Pacific), along the Presidio wall, until the move to Berkeley.

title: Founded Detour
description: Started Detour, a self-funded GPS-triggered audio walking-tour app, launching first in San Francisco.

title: Sebastian born
description: First son, Sebastian.

title: Bought a place in Big Sur
description: Acquired a home in Big Sur.

title: Aspen trip
description: Summer trip to Aspen. (Photo library labels this 2018 — worth a quick double-check.)

title: Sweden / Finland / Russia trip
description: Travel through Sweden, Finland, and Russia.

title: Oscar born
description: Second son, Oscar.

title: Founded Descript
description: Spun Descript out of Detour's transcription-based editing tech (which had emerged ~late 2016), building an AI-powered audio/video editing platform as CEO.

title: Los Cabos at Christmas
description: Holiday trip to Los Cabos.

title: Wirikuta Gardens trip
description: A trip to Wirikuta with friends Tim and Rob.

title: Detour acquired by Bose
description: Bose acquired Detour's software and tour content; the team moved on to Descript.

title: Hawaii trip
description: Trip to Hawaii.

title: Tahoe trip
description: Trip to Lake Tahoe.

title: Moved to Berkeley
description: Relocated to Berkeley as Sebastian was entering kindergarten.

title: Kids' schooling: Berkwood Hedge to Bentley
description: Both sons attended Berkwood Hedge School, then transferred to Bentley School around when Sebastian was in third grade and Oscar in first.

title: Tulum at Christmas
description: Holiday trip to Tulum.

title: Costa Rica trip
description: Trip to Costa Rica.

title: Hawaii trip
description: Return trip to Hawaii.

title: Europe family vacation
description: Family vacation in Europe.

title: Founded Tabletop Library
description: Co-founded Tabletop Library, a membership-based board game club, with Nabeel. (February 2025 is a placeholder date.)

title: Dolomites trip
description: Trip to the Dolomites while the kids were at their first sleepaway camp in the Santa Cruz Mountains.

title: Stepped down as Descript CEO
description: Stepped down from the Descript CEO role.

title: Returned to serious piano study
description: Resumed serious piano lessons (the SFCM / Yoshi Nagai chapter). (~December 2025 is a placeholder date.)

title: Niseko ski trip
description: Skied in Niseko, Japan, with friends Tim, Rob, and Jyri.

title: Tabletop Library launch
description: Planned public launch of Tabletop Library. (Upcoming/forward-looking — the only future-dated entry.)
